recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸碎粒中有正常的骨髓系、紅血球系前驅細胞與小淋巴樣細胞混合，箭頭指向一個小型淋巴樣細胞；在此放大倍率下核裂痕不易辨認，僅能提示淋巴球增加，須配合流式細胞與切片才能確認濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Cellular aspirate particle with mixed trilineage hematopoietic cells
Scattered small lymphoid cells with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm, one indicated by the arrow
Myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, and erythroblasts present in normal proportions at low power
Nuclear contour irregularity of the lymphoid cells cannot be reliably resolved at this magnification
No blast sheets or megakaryocyte abnormality evident
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors admixed with small lymphoid cells, one of which is indicated by the arrow. The lymphoid cells have dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm, but nuclear clefts cannot be confidently resolved at this magnification. No increase in blasts is evident. Findings are compatible with, but not in themselves diagnostic of, marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma; flow cytometry for a CD10-positive clonal B-cell population and trephine biopsy for paratrabecular aggregates are required.

ddx.vs: Hematogones are polytypic with a maturing CD10/CD20/CD34 pattern on flow cytometry, whereas follicular lymphoma shows a light-chain-restricted CD10+ population.
CLL cells are round with block-like chromatin and are CD5+ CD23+ rather than CD10+ cleaved cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma shows CD5+ cyclin D1+ cells with t(11;14).
